messages:
sarah-ng: @support-nyc heads-up — BrightWave (customer) reporting missing audit log entries between 2026-03-15T00:00 and 2026-03-15T01:20 UTC right after our scheduled KMS rotation. They also see sporadic 401s and a `key_wrap_failed` error. Ticket INC-4329 opened. They want a patch ETA for CVE-2026-1823 and confirmation of log retention.

tony-chen: Can you drop the minimal repro they provided and any request IDs/regions?

sarah-ng: Copied from customer:

```
POST /v1/keys/wrap
{ "key_id": "proj-brightwave-kek-2026", "payload": "<base64>" }
Response: 500 {"error":"key_wrap_failed","code":"KWF_500"}
```

They say it started immediately following the automated rotation at 00:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Automated rotation completed for proj-brightwave-kek-2026 at 2026-03-15T00:00:05Z (run-id: rt-20260315-09). Rotation service: rotation-svc-prod.

maria-g: Looping in SecOps + Keystore. Quick checklist: 1) confirm key material present on HSM, 2) inspect wrap/unwrap audit logs, 3) replay rotation in staging, 4) prep a fallback plan to re-run rotation with previous KEK if needed.

kevin-eng: I started a reproducer in staging and see same failure — HSM responds REFUSE_WRAPPER with errcode 0x6F. My hypothesis: thumbprint mismatch on newly minted KEK. Short-term mitigation: re-run rotation with fallback to previous KEK while we apply hotpatch. Command I used in staging:
```
./rotation-tool --project proj-brightwave --key proj-brightwave-kek-2026 --allow-legacy=true --run
```
If that succeeds, it restores wrap compatibility.

jessica-oncall: SecOps note: CVE-2026-1823 patch is available in runtime v1.3.4. We can hotpatch Dedicated clusters in ~4 hours; Hosted (multi-tenant) needs blue/green and ~6 hours. We need SOC sign-off before customer notification. Potential SLA impact: if audit logs are lost we might need to offer replay/compensation — confirm retention first.

support-nyc: Draft reply to BrightWave:
"Thanks for the report — we're investigating KMS keywrap failures after our scheduled rotation. We're able to apply a hotfix within 6 hours and can attempt an immediate mitigation by re-running rotation with a fallback key. We'll confirm whether audit logs are intact and update you hourly. Ticket INC-4329."

sarah-ng: Action items: kevin-eng to run fallback rotation in staging + validate customer flows; jessica-oncall to coordinate SecOps approval and schedule hotfix; tony-chen to pull HSM API logs and correlate request IDs; support-nyc to send the initial customer note and post updates hourly. If customer requests formal disclosure, I'll loop in Legal. I'll also update INC-4329 and link the playbook /playbooks/kms-rotation.

tony-chen: Logs from hsm-proxy (snippet):
```
2026-03-15T00:00:06Z ksm_wrap request_id=abc-789 error=0x6F hsm_response=REFUSE_WRAPPER session=session-az1
```

sarah-ng: Thx. kevin — please post staging run outcome and whether fallback rotation would cause any short-term latencies.

kevin-eng: Staging run with `--allow-legacy=true` succeeded, wrap calls resumed. No obvious data corruption. Expecting ~15-30s of elevated latency during live run while keys are swapped. I'll prepare the rollback steps and a safety window.

jessica-oncall: SecOps approved hotfix rollout. Scheduling now; will post PR link and exact timeline in INC-4329.

support-nyc: Sent initial update to customer at 2026-03-15T00:15Z. BrightWave acknowledged and asked whether audit logs are recoverable and for max ETA.

sarah-ng: Confirmed — we're proceeding with hotfix and fallback rotation. Update every 30m; next sync +30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
